meta.name: cs-draft-response
meta.description: Redige uma resposta profissional voltada ao cliente adaptada à situação e ao relacionamento. Use para responder uma pergunta de produto, responder a uma escalação ou incidente, entregar uma má notícia como atraso ou won't-fix, recusar um feature request, ou responder a um problema de billing. / Draft a professional customer-facing response tailored to the situation and relationship. Use when answering a product question, responding to an escalation or outage, delivering bad news like a delay or won't-fix, declining a feature request, or replying to a billing issue.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 撰写专业客户回复，适配不同场景与关系
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成得体、专业的客户回复邮件或消息。
copy.tagline_en: Draft professional customer-facing responses tailored to the situation and relationship.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate polite and professional customer replies.

howto.what: 根据用户描述的情境（如客户提问、故障、坏消息等），自动生成一封专业、结构完整的客户回复草稿，包含合适的语气、具体内容和下一步行动。
howto.when: 当用户提供客户问题的上下文，例如需要回复产品问题、处理升级、传达坏消息、拒绝功能请求或处理账单问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我会Acme Corp的邮件，回复他们关于新功能上线时间的问题
say.note: 生成回复草稿，包括语气和下一步行动。

say.text: 客户升级说他们的集成已经宕机两天，帮我写回复
say.note: 生成包含承认影响、状态说明和后续计划的回复。

say.text: 我们需要礼貌地拒绝一个功能请求，但给出替代方案
say.note: 生成解释原因并提供替代方案的回复。

howto.what_en: Drafts a professional customer-facing response based on the given situation, including appropriate tone, content, and next steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when user provides context for a customer inquiry, problem, or request, such as answering a product question, handling an escalation, delivering bad news, declining a feature request, or replying to a billing issue.

say_en.text: Draft an email to Acme Corp answering their question about the new feature timeline.
say_en.note: Generates a draft with tone and next steps.

say_en.text: A customer escalated saying their integration has been down for 2 days—write a response.
say_en.note: Generates a reply acknowledging impact, status, and next steps.

say_en.text: We need to politely decline a feature request but offer alternatives.
say_en.note: Generates a response explaining the reason and providing alternatives.
